theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : ℤ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (X : ℤ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n) (C : ℝ≥0∞), 1 ≤ n → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (U j)) → (∀ j, U (j + 1) ⊆ U j) → (∀ (j : ℤ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), X j ω = ∫ x in U j, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + 1)) (n + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ j, (X j).boundary.mass < ∞) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, HasSum (fun j => (X j).boundary η) (T η)) → C < ∞ → (∀ (N : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n), (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, Y η = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) N, (X j).boundary η) → Y.mass ≤ C) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
